0022600105.text: The Cavaliers, hosting this game, are 0-1 and sit 13th in the East and fourth in the Central, one game back, while the Brooklyn Nets are also 0-1 and 10th in the East. Brooklyn will be without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder injury. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Cleveland won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 106-102 win in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026.
